error.SECRET_SESSION_RESERVED: Session credentials cannot be read, granted, set or deleted by name. Use models login or models logout.
error.SIWC_STORE_NOT_PERSONAL: Personal local custody is unverified. Disconnect the connection; do not move its session records by changing stores.
error.SUBSCRIPTION_RAW_USE_REFUSED: Only Deckent features may use this subscription for an AI caller. Raw model access from other tools is refused.
siwc.card.title: Continue with ChatGPT
siwc.card.body: Eligible requests use your ChatGPT plan. Deckent does not charge for this connection. Authorize Deckent in your browser.
siwc.privacy.body: Deckent receives account identity and session credentials, stored only in your own local encrypted store. It does not read your ChatGPT conversations.
siwc.card.connectedAppOnly: Other tools connected over MCP cannot use your plan as a raw API.
siwc.card.background: Allow Deckent features such as Brain planning, recovery and evaluation to use the plan in the background?
siwc.card.apiQuestion: Continue on an exact API model at a confirmed ChatGPT limit?
siwc.card.apiCost: Optional and revocable. API use spends your budget and may change the model, behavior or capabilities. Temporary errors never switch to API.
siwc.card.approvalPending: A configuration approval is pending. Complete the approval before using this model.
siwc.browser.waiting: Authorize Deckent in your browser… {seconds}s · Esc cancels
siwc.browser.fallback: If your browser did not open, open this sign-in link. The callback listener remains open:
siwc.cancelled: ChatGPT sign-in cancelled. Run the same command again to sign in.
siwc.welcome.body: You are using your ChatGPT plan. Manage usage in ChatGPT settings.
siwc.welcome.ready: Connection saved. Check model availability with /model.
siwc.revoke.title: Disconnect ChatGPT
siwc.revoke.unconfirmed: Remote revocation was not confirmed. Remove Deckent in ChatGPT Settings → Security → Sign in with ChatGPT.
siwc.switch.notice: ChatGPT limit reached → continuing with {model} from your API budget.
siwc.usageUnavailable: Usage cannot be checked now. Try later or check the connection.
siwc.serviceUnavailable: The plan is temporarily unavailable. Try later.
siwc.usage.limit: Usage limit reached (your ChatGPT plan or this app). Manage usage or try later.
siwc.help: models connect|login|logout --connection <ChatGPT connection> --scope <scope> [--connection-id <id>] (person TTY only). Reconnect to change or revoke background/API consent. Use --new-account after logout to authorize a different account; it never rotates on limits.
siwc.custody.personalRequired: Use your own local store, then reconnect ChatGPT.
siwc.custody.cleanupPending: Previous credential cleanup is incomplete. Reconcile it before reconnecting.
siwc.custody.nonPersonOwner: A person must sign in from their own terminal.
siwc.notEligible: This ChatGPT plan cannot be used here. Choose another connection or manage your plan.
siwc.usage.title: Deckent usage
siwc.usage.summary: Last {days} days, completed requests in Deckent: {total}; busiest day: {busiest}; active days: {active}. These are not your remaining ChatGPT limits.
siwc.usage.unknown: Usage summary is unavailable; no zero or reset time is inferred.
siwc.card.revokeConsent: Turn off background use and API continuation
siwc.custody.profileRequired: Select a resolved installation identity profile in local setup, then reconnect ChatGPT.
siwc.doctor.disabled: Plan use is disabled, expired or awaiting reconnect. Inspect the connection in /provider.
siwc.account.signOutFirst: Disconnect the current ChatGPT connection before authorizing a different account. Limits never rotate accounts.
siwc.help.action.logout: Sign a ChatGPT connection out and revoke its sign-in (your terminal)
error.SIWC_WORKER_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE: The isolated worker cannot prove its boundary ({check}). Nothing was sent and no effect ran; repair the worker setup (/setup image). There is no host fallback.
error.SIWC_APP_SERVER_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE: The worker's embedded Codex cannot use the private model connection ({reason}). No ChatGPT token entered the worker; use /setup image or wait for activation.
error.SIWC_RELAY_REFUSED: Model connection refused ({reason}). No request reached the plan; reconnect or restart the work.
error.SIWC_APP_SERVER_EFFECT_UNKNOWN: The worker's last native effect is unknown. Its evidence is kept; reconcile it before restarting.
error.SIWC_WORKER_CLEANUP_UNPROVEN: The worker's stop could not be verified. Relaunch is blocked until recovery proves it stopped.
siwc.worker.activationHold: The Codex worker on your ChatGPT plan is not activated yet; nothing was sent and no effect ran. OpenAI's documentation marks the Codex app-server command and its WebSocket transport as experimental: Deckent's boundary proof for the pinned binary and transport is not vendor production support or a compliance approval of this combination, so an unsupported combination stops with this typed refusal before any authenticated work. Use an already supported worker connection meanwhile.
siwc.custody.privateFolder: ChatGPT sign-in refused: {path} has mode {mode}, too open for your session credentials. Make it private with `chmod 700 {path}`, then sign in again. Deckent did not change any permission.
siwc.custody.privateParent: ChatGPT sign-in refused: {path} (mode {mode}) can be changed by other users, so no store under it is private. Keep Deckent's global folder under a private parent such as your home folder (DECKENT_GLOBAL_HOME), then sign in again.
siwc.custody.unsafeRoot: ChatGPT sign-in refused: the credential store folder or one of its parents is open to other users. `deckent doctor` names the folder and the fix. Deckent did not change any permission.
siwc.custody.localDisk: ChatGPT sign-in refused: session credentials must stay on this computer's own local disk, not a network share, /mnt/c or an unrecognized device. Keep Deckent's global folder on the local disk, for example under your home folder.
siwc.doctor.custodyReady: ChatGPT sign-in storage: your private local encrypted store
siwc.doctor.custodyStore: ChatGPT sign-in would be refused: it needs the encrypted secret store; this installation uses {backend}.
siwc.doctor.custodyUntested: ChatGPT sign-in storage was not checked ({reason}).
